definition: A BCI connection that has gone dormant or unresponsive, either from death of the user, deliberate disconnection, or ELF interference. Receiving a cold signal from someone you thought was alive is considered a death notification in street culture.
origin: Technical telecommunications term adopted into everyday BCI vernacular
usage: Universal — medical staff, street crews, families, investigators
example: I pinged Dashi three times this morning — nothing but cold signal. Something happened down in the Narrows.
